name: TaskFlow fixed external gold tests · SOL vs ASTRA IQ3_S
description: Repeated comparison with 13 fixed functional acceptance checks plus syntax compilation; task scoring excludes infrastructure/protocol failures.

prompts.prompt:
Return the complete contents of `solution_taskflow_fixed_gold.py` as your entire response. The benchmark harness saves your final response as that artifact and then runs the acceptance suite. Do not call tools; do not output thoughts, `<think>` tags, Markdown fences, explanation, or a plan. Output only valid Python source, starting with imports or a module docstring. Keep implementation concise enough to fit the response limit.

Implement a Python 3.10+ task manager using only the standard library. Public API: `Task` dataclass fields id, title, description, priority, status, tags, depends_on, recurrence, created_at, updated_at, due_date, completed_at; `TaskService` methods create_task, list_tasks, get_task, update_task, set_status, complete_task, reopen_task, cancel_task, delete_task, add_dependency, blocked_by, ready_tasks, history, undo, summary, export_markdown, export_csv; `JsonTaskStorage(path)` load/save; functions `next_occurrence(date_iso, recurrence)`, `parse_query(text)`, `apply_query(tasks, filters)`, `markdown_report(tasks, summary)`.

Contract: priorities low/medium/high/urgent; statuses todo/doing/blocked/done/cancelled; recurrence daily/weekly/monthly. Reject blank titles. Normalize/dedupe tags and dependency IDs. Preserve increasing IDs after persistence. Raise KeyError for missing tasks/dependencies; reject dependency cycles; block completion until dependencies are done. Completion sets completed_at and creates the next recurring occurrence. Monthly recurrence clamps to month end. `undo()` reverses the latest mutation including completion and a recurrence-created row, restoring every field. Ready/blocked and summary are accurate. Combined filters search title/description case-insensitively. Storage tolerates missing/corrupt JSON and skips malformed rows, writes atomically, and is thread-safe. 40 concurrent creates produce unique consecutive IDs. Markdown/CSV exports include task data.

The fixed suite has 13 external functional checks plus `py_compile`, identical for every profile. Implement the contract directly; do not attempt to write or inspect tests. No extra files.
